The '''Raid on Gestron''' took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]' [[Garm Bel Iblis's movement|forces]] attacked the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at [[Gestron]]. [[Irenez (Human)|Irenez]] played a pivotal part in the raid.<ref name="DFRSb" />
